race.comment: AZARAX (3) talented gelding who maps well third up. Sat on the fast tempo with a tiring fifth over 1400m at Rosehill in weaker company. Drops 3.5kg and finds a winnable race on his home track. SHE MOVES TOO (4) is a stakes-placed mare who makes plenty of appeal at her fourth run back today. Comes down from Queensland after she savaged the line with a narrow second over 1600m at Doomben. Finds a suitable race and look for her to swoop late. AGENT ZERO (1) gripped on late in a solid rating contest first up to secure third over 1400m at Randwick Kensington. Senior rider hops aboard and can stalk the speed from the awkward draw. Each way. DONATELLO (7) consistent gelding who deserves his chance here after closing strongly with the 59kg to run second at Warwick Farm over 1400m. Worth more than a passing glance. SPREAD THE LOVE (9) Highway placing had merit and goes into the exotics from the low draw.
